records.source_statement: Subsection asks about a woman's purported honesty, using lunar face, ascending sign modality and first lord.
limitations: Seventeenth-century judgment; no factual assessment of any person.

records.source_statement: Moon in last face of Gemini is presented as an alleged adverse signal, subject to other placements.
limitations: Do not omit qualifiers or assert accuracy.

records.source_statement: Movable/common ascendant or Moon with weak first ruler is described as a contrary source sign, while fixed dignified first ruler may override.
limitations: Combinations matter more than a single sign.

records.source_statement: Moon in ascendant with Saturn can be interpreted as sexual contact by force and against the person's consent, not voluntary misconduct.
limitations: Critically preserve nonconsent; never equate victimization with wrongdoing.

records.source_statement: Ascendant and its lord fixed despite Moon in movable sign can be interpreted favourably rather than negatively.
limitations: This is an explicit counterexample to a simplistic movable Moon conclusion.

records.source_statement: First lord in fifth or fifth lord in first and corporeal contact is associated by Lilly with possible recent conception or relationship.
limitations: Alternative hypothetical events, no pregnancy or paternity verification.

records.source_statement: Planets separated by roughly three degrees in the same scheme are offered as evidence an earlier concern may no longer apply.
limitations: Source uses precise angular threshold and before/after distinctions.
